Creation is wall time for the entire batch, excluding first status. Values are medians of recorded rounds; one round is an observation, not a stable estimate. Allocation is additional filesystem-allocated MiB after first status, including indexes, staging and APFS metadata. Ranges retain observed allocator variation, not confidence intervals. Multipliers use unrounded point estimates. Missing measurements are not zeros; logical size and du do not measure exclusive APFS allocation.

- Warm-cache observations on a shared Apple M1 Ultra Mac using Git 2.56.1; three paired rounds per workload/backend/environment. These are not cold-cache results or universal speed guarantees.
- Every completed cohort independently verified bytes, executable modes, symlink targets, native Twig selection, and source isolation after private writes. The nine complete jobs contain 3,780 verified measured creates with zero failures; warmups are additional and not timed.
- Workers starter, git-twig and Axo each create 100 worktrees with up to 100 in flight. Kernel and OpenClaw each create ten worktrees sequentially. Prior workload commits are preserved; the git-twig workload is the same historical tree, not the latest project checkout.
- Host-APFS timing and isolated case-sensitive APFS allocation are separate runs with identical pinned inputs and candidate binary. Kernel time and allocation both use the same case-sensitive-image cohorts. Do not compare absolute workload times as if counts and environments were identical.
- OpenClaw is pinned at 410c0dda40702e25263b49b8b7d0786a5e49e366 with its text=auto eol=lf attributes unchanged. No OpenClaw application or dependencies were run. Every created Twig worktree selected native CoW.
- The frozen candidate implements the v0.4 checkout changes at source 47c9216 before the version-only release bump; its executable still reports 0.3.0. Candidate SHA-256 and all input pins are in each raw run and the campaign manifests. Do not confuse it with the published v0.3.0 binary.
- All setup failures remain versioned: linux-images.json stopped at second-round warmup cleanup, openclaw-host.json had no measured cohorts because its new bare input lacked a branch reference, and openclaw-images.json stopped at second-round warmup cleanup. These incomplete attempts are not headline data; no measured creation was retried. The full kernel and OpenClaw jobs were rerun under new filenames.
- The final OpenClaw allocation job uses a separately hashed harness with an owned-warmup cleanup recovery outside measurement. It recovers only Git's partial Directory-not-empty deletion on disposable fixtures, asserts the warmup registration is gone before the baseline, and records warmupCleanupRecovered per cohort (one recovery). Timed creation/verification/allocation logic and the candidate binary are unchanged. Original binaries, failed attempts and continuation provenance are retained.
- The original November 15 measurements remain archived under bench/results/2026-11-15-real; they are not silently overwritten or combined into this rerun. See the [campaign manifest](../../bench/results/2026-11-16-apfs/manifest.json) and [completion record](../../bench/results/2026-11-16-apfs/completion.json).
